Check meteo data input as required by the 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/check_meteo_3DFEM.R
check_meteo_3DFEM.Rd

check_meteo_3DFEM perform some basic test on the variables in the input meteo file (e.g., generated by the function make_meteo_EOBS) to ensure compatibility with run_3DCMCCFEM. The function can also try to correct inconsistency

Usage

check_meteo_3DFEM(
  file_meteo,
  correct = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  save = FALSE,
  plot = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

file_meteo

Character or data.frame: path to meteo.txt file or data.frame of meteo.txt file read with read.table.

correct

Logical: correct any errors found? Default to TRUE.

impute

Logical: impute missing value using tree-based algorithm (bagging, requires the packages caret and ipred)? Default to TRUE.

save

Logical: save meteo file?. Only if file_meteo is a path to a file. If TRUE, meteo file is saved with the same name and same directory of file_meteo. Default to FALSE

plot

Logical: plot meteo file with plot_meteo_3DFEM?. Default to FALSE.

...

additional argument passed to plot_meteo_3DFEM when plot=TRUE

Value

a data.frame with the corrected weather time series if correct=TRUE, invisible otherwise. If plot=TRUE the function return a ggplot object if save_plot=FALSE. If save_plot=TRUE the function save in outdir a png file with the name of the site in meteo_path_file

Details

The function check for consistency with the columns name convention of the model, for NA, missing data, missing observation in the weather time series, anomalous values in precipitation and temperature relations (i.e., Tmin<=Tmean<=Tmax). If correct=TRUE colnames and temperature are fixed according to model specifications. After all checks, if plot=TRUE the function plot_meteo_3DFEM is call.

See also

make_meteo_EOBS and plot_meteo_3DFEM
